description: Source code for a DRM system implementation for PlayReady on Windows, including session management, license handling, and key status reporting.

classes.name: ActiveDrmSystems
classes.description: Manages active DRM system instances with thread safety.

classes.name: starboard::shared::win32::DrmSystemPlayready
classes.description: Implements PlayReady DRM system functionalities including license management and session control.

methods.name: GetHexRepresentation
methods.description: Converts binary data to a hex string with ASCII representation for debugging.

methods.name: GenerateAndAdvanceSessionId
methods.description: Generates a new unique session ID.

methods.name: IsKeySystemSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given key system string is supported (specifically PlayReady).

methods.name: GenerateSessionUpdateRequest
methods.description: Creates a license request challenge for a session.

methods.name: UpdateSession
methods.description: Processes a license response and updates session key status.

methods.name: CloseSession
methods.description: Closes a DRM session and cleans up related data.

methods.name: Decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption of media samples, checking for key validity and HDCP requirements.

methods.name: ReportKeyStatusChanged_Locked
methods.description: Reports changes in key status to the callback.

methods.name: GetLicense
methods.description: Retrieves the license object associated with a key ID.

methods.name: OnUwpResume
methods.description: Handles UWP resume event, closing sessions as needed.
